caption: Rewriting should fix weak phrasing without inventing metrics. In JobRez, grounded rewrites are rule-based. They replace weak openers, remove filler, fix capitalisation and punctuation, list every change, and never add numbers, tools, or employers. Learn more at https://jobrez.com.
